:::{#def-derivation}
#### Derivation

A **derivation** is a proof (@def-proof), or a part of one,
written as a chain of expressions, one per line,
in which each line is joined to the line before it
by $=$ or by an inequality sign (@def-inequality),
and carries an annotation that names the reason that step holds:
an assumption, a definition, a previously proved result, or a rule of algebra.

:::
